header.name: Data Processing and Management
header.description: This main objective of this course is to train Mtech students in ECE, specially the CSP and CPS students, to be able to code end to end systems in Python. The course will fulfill a key gap that was highlighted during our interactions with industry and past students on increasing the ability of students to code what they learn during the Mtech program. The course will cover basics of Python, databases, data management methods and packages that include Pandas, SQLalchemy etc. Finally, the course will also cover tools and methods related to devops and end to end applications deployment, preferably through Jupyter notebooks and or flask frameworks. The course will be mainly hands on with assignments every week that will culminate in a sufficiently large and deployable project at the end of the semester. The students should be able to complement this course with their research interests in signal processing and machine learning so that they can code and test simple algorithms rapidly.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: To be able to decide relevant tools/services in the development of end to end applications using Python and its frameworks.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: To be able to code from scratch simple applications involving data using Pandas and be able to inform basic data analysis.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: To be able to code simple full stack end to end applications in application areas involving machine learning and/or data engineering/management.

lecture_topics: Simple problems that involve both algorithms and data structures in Python, using virtual environment
Accessing data using File I/0, databases etc
Data Pipelines and performing basic Data Analysis (using e.g scikit-learn)
Threading —> using example and an assignment
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: 4 assignments: 1. Simple data structure and algorithms, 2. Numpy, Visualisation, Processing of JSON data and Scikit-learn, 3. OOP, modules and packages, 4. Threading and Multiprocessing.

lecture_topics: Examples from NLP (text) , Audio, Video and geospatial data sets
Deployment of a project (end to end)
Deployment of a jupyter notebook on server and accessing your python code from anywhere
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Assignments: Containerisation, simple Jupyter notebook deployment
